_comment: sim-place-descent-watchdog-suspend-v1. Purpose: keep the per-frame /sensors watchdog AND the parked-collect-station liveness watchdog tight everywhere EXCEPT the one window where a sensor-stream stall is legitimate -- the loaded place descent (the collect set-down onto the cart deck and the live_pose transfer place onto the bay). In coldwin64 the run passed everything up to and including the loaded set-down (seeded pre-place converged at 1.09 deg, the full six-axis base lock held at peak 125.8/600, the carton was placed and released at true shelf contact), then the per-frame sensor-stream watchdog expired during the slow loaded descent (HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=place 'sensor stream watchdog expired', sim gap ~30 s while the sim was healthy), which cascaded into the parked collect station losing its heartbeat ('parked heartbeat lost: sim gap 30.02 s'), a latched global /manipulation/stop, and an endless collect retry loop. Under sensing_stride 8 plus a 2nd full-resolution render for live_pose the /sensors stream legitimately has sim gaps well above the 1.0 s per-frame bound across the descent. These two sibling keys suspend ONLY that one window; both default off => byte-identical. They REPLACE the coldwin65 env-widen stopgap (RESTOCK_SENSOR_WATCHDOG_S / RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S), which loosens the watchdogs for the WHOLE run.
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by ros_host.py -> RosTransferBridge, the HOST manip process).
_place_descent_sensor_watchdog_suspend_n: Suspend the per-frame /sensors SIM-clock watchdog (RESTOCK_SENSOR_WATCHDOG_S default 1.0 sim-s) ONLY while the controller is in the loaded place descent (controller.in_loaded_place_descent(): phase=='place' AND the carton is held). On entry it logs 'SENSOR_WATCHDOG_SUSPENDED phase=place reason=loaded_descent ...' and on exit (release / phase exit) 'SENSOR_WATCHDOG_REARMED ...', so a run log shows the exact window. The 180 s /sensors WALL backstop (RESTOCK_SENSOR_STREAM_WALL_BACKSTOP_S) stays armed throughout, so a genuinely frozen sim is still caught even inside the window. Never suspended outside the loaded descent. Default off => byte-identical. Validated in tests/test_ros_adapter_watchdog.py (PlaceDescentSensorWatchdogSuspend).
_runtime_block: Merge into the mission RUNTIME config block (mission-runtime-*.json, read by scripts/twin/restock/isaac_bundle.py -> RuntimeAdapter, the orchestrate process).
_collect_place_station_pause_note: PAUSE the parked collect station (StationClient.pause() -> host 'paused', NOT faulted; publishes NO global stop) when the collect op enters the loaded place descent (action collect, repositioned, _last_manip_phase=='place'), so the same /sensors render-pacing stall cannot starve the station's parked-heartbeat liveness watchdog and latch the global stop (coldwin64 'parked heartbeat lost: sim gap 30.02 s'). Same mechanism the between-ops couple tow already uses (sim-robust-station-pause-on-transfer-v1). One-shot per collect (logs 'COLLECT_PLACE_STATION_PAUSE ...'); the next op (couple) re-prepares a fresh epoch and clears the pause. Default off => byte-identical (no pause command sent). Validated in tests/test_restock_runtime.py (test_collect_place_pauses_the_parked_station_once_when_enabled / _off_never_suspend_pauses).
_requires: Both keys are registered in config_preflight.KEY_CONSUMER (place_descent_sensor_watchdog_suspend -> HOST, collect_place_station_pause -> RUNTIME), so a key filed in the wrong config file is refused before the GPU boot (the run-277 slip). Add both to the run's --require list so the preflight asserts each activated in the process that reads it. They are siblings: for full coverage of the coldwin64 cascade set BOTH (scope 1 stops the HOST sensor-watchdog trip; scope 2 stops the station-heartbeat trip). Remove the coldwin65 env widen (RESTOCK_SENSOR_WATCHDOG_S / RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S) from the run env -- these phase-scoped keys replace it and keep the watchdogs tight everywhere else.
_bounded_gpu_proof: Re-run the coldwin64 config (the full cold run: GROUND-TRUTH collect, RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose with RESTOCK_TRANSFER_CARRY=wrist_guard, the PR 333/334 place_contact_release + closed_loop_sensor, PR 339 station_place_full_brake, the PR 209/211 collect-place keys) through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), with place_descent_sensor_watchdog_suspend:true in the HOST block and collect_place_station_pause:true in the RUNTIME block, and WITHOUT the coldwin65 env widen. Expected PASS: the run reaches the loaded place descent exactly as coldwin64 did, the host log shows SENSOR_WATCHDOG_SUSPENDED ... at the descent entry and COLLECT_PLACE_STATION_PAUSE (no HOST_FAULT_ESTOP 'sensor stream watchdog expired', no STATION_ESTOP_PUBLISH 'parked heartbeat lost'), the carton is placed + released at contact, SENSOR_WATCHDOG_REARMED fires on release, and the mission continues (collect DONE -> couple) toward the complete whole-run video instead of the endless collect retry loop. A genuinely frozen sim inside the window still hard-stops on the 180 s /sensors WALL backstop (named 'sensor stream wall backstop expired').
